description.zh-CN: 终端里的 AI 结对编程助手：在你的 git 仓库里直接对话改文件、自动提交，支持几乎所有主流云端模型和本地 Ollama；全局配置写在 ~/.aider.conf.yml。
description.en: AI pair programmer in your terminal — chats with you and edits files straight inside your git repo (auto-commits as it works); works with every major cloud model or local Ollama, global config lives in ~/.aider.conf.yml.

runtime.note: Hard prerequisite: Python 3.10–3.12 (PyPI requires_python ">=3.10,<3.13" measured 2026-11-14). Windows: a real `python` on PATH (python.org per-user install — zero admin; the Microsoft Store stub does not count). macOS: `python3` (CLT ships 3.9 on older systems — install python.org 3.12 if `python3 --version` is too old). Install is `pip install --user`, fully inside the user profile, no admin. Release channel note: aider publishes to PyPI (0.86.2 measured there); its GitHub Releases latest tag is v0.86.0, so the daily probe tracks the GitHub tag while the package version tracks PyPI.

direct-install.label: Official PyPI install (hash-verified wheel, user-level pip)
direct-install.note: Downloads the official PyPI wheel and installs it with `pip install --user`; steps contain both platform packages and are filtered by machine arch. No CN gateway applies (PyPI asset, not GitHub) — CN users get fast dependency resolution by exporting PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple at install time.

netConfig.registrySourcesNote: Registry JSON cross-check from multiple sources (any two must agree); this app ships no GitHub assets — the wheel hash came from the PyPI JSON API digest plus a full local download (2026-11-14).

openai.label: OpenAI official API
openai.notes: Aider reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment (official "Connecting to LLMs" docs, measured 2026-11-14); options can also be set in ~/.aider.conf.yml (searched in git root, cwd or home — official config docs). AiBOX never writes keys to disk.

anthropic.label: Anthropic official API (Claude)
anthropic.notes: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY via environment variable; same config file as openai.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (one key, every model)
openrouter.notes: OPENROUTER_API_KEY via environment variable; aider documents OpenRouter among its supported LLMs.

ollama.label: Local Ollama models (free, offline, no key)
ollama.notes: Aider officially documents Ollama as a local backend (Connecting to LLMs → Ollama); point --model at ollama/<name> or set it in ~/.aider.conf.yml. No key involved.

upgrade.notes: Upgrade = `python -m pip install --upgrade --user aider-chat` (Windows: `python`), or re-run the AiBOX install route with the newer wheel. Check = `python -m pip show aider-chat` against the version the daily probe records. macOS uses `python3`.

steps: Uninstall the package: `python -m pip uninstall -y aider-chat` (macOS: `python3 -m pip ...`)
Delete the global config if you created one: ~/.aider.conf.yml
Optional: remove history/log files inside your repositories — .aider.input.history, .aider.chat.history.md (they live in the project, not the home directory, so AiBOX never touches them)
uninstall.notes: pip --user only removes what it installed; virtualenvs created by other tools are unaffected. If you installed aider yourself into a venv, uninstall inside that venv instead.

risk.onUninstall: The tool and its global config (~/.aider.conf.yml) are removed — if you pasted API keys or model settings there, export them first; chat history files inside your repositories are not touched by AiBOX. / 会删除 aider 程序本体与全局配置 ~/.aider.conf.yml——如果里面写了 API Key 或模型设置请先导出；各仓库里的对话历史文件 AiBOX 不会动。
